meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能用 dial 命令行通过一个真实手机号发送短信、发起由 AI 语音代理接听的通话,并等待接收入站短信或验证码。它会返回发送结果、通话记录和收到的短信内容。
howto.when: 当你提到电话、短信、验证码等关键词,或要求给人发短信、打电话、等验证码时触发;一次会话里首次运行 dial 命令前也会加载。

say.text: 用 +14155550123 发条短信:会议改到下午三点
给 +14155550123 打个电话,问明天是否营业
say.note: 通话结束后用 dial call get 取结果

say.text: 等一条验证码短信,收到就告诉我
say.note: 用 dial wait-for 监听短信

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use the dial CLI to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and wait for inbound texts or verification codes through a real phone number. It returns send results, call records, and received message contents.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention phones, calls, SMS, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; ask to text, call, or wait for a code; or before Claude runs any dial command for the first time.

say_en.text: Text +14155550123 that the meeting moved to 3pm
Call +14155550123 and ask if they're open tomorrow
say_en.note: Read the result with dial call get

say_en.text: Wait for a verification code text and tell me the code
